title: Installation & Commissioning
subtitle: Seamless Setup. Maximum Performance. Long-Term Assurance.
description: Our Installation & Commissioning service goes beyond basic mechanical setup. It forms the core foundation of a safe, efficient solar system. We handle mechanical frame mounting, panel alignment, inverter integration, routing protection, DISCOM net-metering synchronization, and power evacuation to your LT panel with zero downtime transition.

offers.title: Optimal Angle Mounts
offers.desc: Structural positioning calibrated using geo-mapping to maximize year-round solar capture.

offers.title: Secure Cabling Setup

standout_heading: Why Our Installation Services Stand Out

standout_points.title: Precision Engineering
standout_points.desc: We use laser alignment and torque wrenches to mount panel structures. Certified technicians follow clear manufacturer guidelines to ensure mechanical fits do not stress modules.

standout_points.title: Safety-First Grounding
standout_points.desc: We install copper-bonded earth rods and chemical fillings to guarantee earth resistance under 2 Ohms, protecting panels, inverters, and human personnel from ground surges.

standout_points.title: Zero Downtime Transition
standout_points.desc: We plan LT panel linkages systematically. Power cutovers are scheduled at off-peak hours, ensuring zero disruption to industrial lines or operations during connection.

faqs.q: How long does the installation and commissioning process take?
faqs.a: For a standard rooftop system (10kW - 100kW), installation takes 5 to 10 days. Commissioning approvals and net meter swap by the DISCOM can take an additional 15 to 30 days depending on department processes.

faqs.q: What testing is performed before the system goes live?
faqs.a: We perform Open Circuit Voltage (Voc), Short Circuit Current (Isc), insulation resistance checks, earth resistance verification, polarity mapping, thermal hot-spot check, and anti-islanding safety tests.

We offer daily remote performance tracking, chemical-free panel washing, string audits, and instant on-site troubleshooting to ensure maximum uptime.

offers.title: Panel Soiling Audits

offers.title: On-Site Repairs

standout_heading: Why Our O&M Services Stand Out

standout_points.title: SCADA Remote Analytics
standout_points.desc: Our centralized desk monitors inverter parameters. If generation dips at a particular inverter string, our team receives an immediate warning, triggering a priority inspection visit.

standout_points.title: De-Ionized Water Wash

standout_points.title: Guaranteed 99% Uptime

faqs.q: How frequently should solar panels be cleaned?
faqs.a: For cities and dry regions, cleaning panels every 12 to 15 days is recommended to prevent dust layers from blocking sunlight. High-dust regions near quarries or dry land may require a weekly wash.

faqs.q: Do you offer AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) for plants built by other companies?
faqs.a: Yes. We conduct a complete health audit of your existing plant, correct any initial cable/structural defects, and take over the system under standard monthly or quarterly O&M plans.

offers.title: Staad Pro Structure Design

offers.title: Cable Routing Layout

offers.title: Electrical SLDs

standout_heading: Why Our Solar Designing Stands Out

standout_points.title: PVsyst Yield Verification
standout_points.desc: We generate precise PVsyst simulations using coordinates and solar irradiation database inputs. This gives clients realistic generation numbers to check ROI before spending.

standout_points.title: Wind-Resilient Structure Models
standout_points.desc: Mount designs conform strictly to IS-875 wind code parameters. Structures are engineered to withstand region-specific storm drafts, ensuring safety on high buildings.

standout_points.title: Optimized Materials Lists

faqs.q: What software package do you use for modeling?

Even small shade spots on single panels can drag down string generation via panel mismatch. A 3D model identifies parapet or tree shadows, placing strings outside blocked sectors.

We provide complete administrative, legal, and operational coordination to help you clear applications, secure clearances, and construct plants safely.

offers.desc: Subsidy-compliant equipment installation, water flow checks, and structure setups.

standout_heading: Why Our Consultation Services Stand Out

standout_points.title: Scheme-Compliant Equipment
standout_points.desc: We source pumps and module components that match strict MNRE quality criteria. This guarantees that your installation passes department reviews and secures funding approvals.

standout_points.title: Subsidy Clearing Liaison
standout_points.desc: Our dedicated operations division works directly with local department officers in Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh to resolve documentation issues and expedite pump approvals.

standout_points.title: Comprehensive Farm Feasibility
standout_points.desc: We verify nearby grid lines and test water tables before starting. This ensures we install the correct pump capacity (HP) and panel tilt for optimal daily irrigation.

faqs.q: What is the farmer share of cost under the KUSUM scheme?
faqs.a: Under PM-KUSUM, the central and state governments cover 60% of the cost as direct subsidies. The farmer pays 40%, which can often be split into a 10% cash contribution and 30% secured via bank loan.

faqs.q: What is the difference between KUSUM Component B and Component C?
faqs.a: Component B focuses on installing stand-alone off-grid solar agricultural pumps. Component C provides support to solarize existing grid-connected agriculture pumps, allowing farmers to sell excess power to utility lines.

title: PM Surya Ghar Yojana
subtitle: Government-Backed Rooftop Solar Subsidy for Residential Consumers.
description: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana is the Government of India's flagship rooftop solar initiative, targeting 1 crore households with free solar electricity. Under this scheme, eligible residential homeowners can install rooftop solar power plants and receive direct central subsidies of up to ₹78,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Sor Connect is an officially empanelled EPC installer — we manage the entire lifecycle from portal registration and DISCOM net-metering to turnkey rooftop installation and subsidy release with zero hassle.

faqs.q: How much subsidy do I get under PM Surya Ghar Yojana?
faqs.a: The central government provides ₹30,000 for 1kW systems, ₹60,000 for 2kW systems, and a maximum of ₹78,000 for systems 3kW and above. The subsidy is directly credited to the consumer's bank account via DBT after installation and net-meter commissioning.

faqs.q: How much roof space is required for a 3kW solar system?
faqs.a: A typical 3kW solar system requires approximately 250 to 300 square feet of shadow-free rooftop space. Our engineers conduct a free site assessment to verify your roof's feasibility and optimal layout.
